results.quote: Given a graph G with n=|V(G)|, one can compute the list of all PMCs of G in output-linear time \tilde{O}(|\Pi_G|)=O(n^4m|\Pi_G|).

results.problem: Treewidth, Minimum Fill-In, lis-(tw\le t), max-(tw\le t,\varphi)
results.bound: \tilde{O}(|\Pi_G|) for treewidth and minimum fill-in; O(n^{O(t)}|\Pi_G|) for lis-(tw\le t); O(n^{O(t)}\cdot f(t,\varphi)\cdot|\Pi_G|) for max-(tw\le t,\varphi)
results.previous_best: required \Pi_G as input; PMC enumeration was output-quadratic O(n^2 m |\Delta_G|^2)
results.quote: treewidth and minimum fill-in can be solved in \tilde{O}(|\Pi_G|), lis-(tw\le t) can be solved in O(n^{O(t)}|\Pi_G|), max-(tw\le t,\varphi) can be solved in O(n^{O(t)}\cdot f(t,\varphi)\cdot|\Pi_G|), without the need to possess initially the list of PMCs.
There is an algorithm deciding PMC Superset in time O(n^3m). Furthermore, for a yes-instance, it produces a solution PMC.
